title: Check DNS Resolution
description: Verify that a hostname resolves correctly.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

HOST="${1:-example.com}"

if getent hosts "$HOST" >/dev/null; then
    echo "OK: DNS resolution succeeded for $HOST."
    getent hosts "$HOST"
else
    echo "ERROR: DNS resolution failed for $HOST." >&2
    exit 1
fi
